messages:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in on the Sierra reserved pool — posting today's capacity snapshot. Overnight we saw a sustained spike; queue depth hit 24 and avg saturation ~88% between 00:30–06:00 UTC. GPU hours +22% vs last week.
ops-bot: alert: reserved-pool:sierra saturation >85% for 3h (auto-notify)
Priya Patel: thanks — is this tenant-driven or a broader backlog?
Maya Chen: looks tenant-heavy. Sierra-prod accounts for ~63% of queued jobs in the window. Also a tail latency bump on longer traces.
Sam O'Neill: can you paste the query you used to generate the snapshot?
Maya Chen: ran a quick rollup, snippet below:
```
SELECT hour, sum(gpu_hours) gpu_hours, max(queue_depth) max_q
FROM reserved_usage
WHERE pool='sierra' AND ts >= '2026-03-14' AND ts < '2026-03-21'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour DESC
LIMIT 48;
```
Priya Patel: ok rough numbers?
Maya Chen: last 24h: GPU hours = 1,820 (+18% w/w), peak hour = 210 GPUh, peak queue_depth = 24, median token latency = 132ms -> tail ~178ms. Error rate steady ~0.4%.
Nikhil Rao: any scheduled runs from their side? Sierra still onboarding, could be an automated batch.
Maya Chen: confirmed — they ran an unscheduled batch rerank at ~02:00 that wasn't in the onboarding calendar. Reached out to their eng lead.
Sam O'Neill: short-term ops options: (1) temporarily bump reserved slots +4 for 6h, (2) enable queue-priority for latency-sensitive routes, (3) request Sierra move batch to a different window. Thoughts?
Priya Patel: first ask Sierra to shift. If no reply in 30m, prep the +4 bump.
Maya Chen: pinged sierra.eng@customer.com — waiting. If no ack by 14:45 PT we'll spin up the bump.
ops-bot: deploy-request: reserved-pool:sierra increase +4 slots — pending approval
Sam O'Neill: approved. I'll lock the bump and watch metrics. Also adding a temporary rate limit on long-run batch jobs to protect tail latency.
Maya Chen: noted. I'll update the account doc and flag renewal-risk as 'medium' if these spikes persist. Scheduling an enablement call to walk them through best practices for batch jobs and job-priorities.
Priya Patel: will log follow-up actions in CS tracker and include recommended config for queue-priority and per-job rate-limits.
Maya Chen: I'll close this thread once the bump completes or Sierra confirms schedule change. :thumbsup:
